headline: Camps, clinics & training plans
intro: Not every rider needs one-to-one coaching. Learn a skill in an afternoon, spend a weekend riding the Hill Country, or follow one of my ready-made training plans.
image_alt: Three riders cornering together on a quiet road

sections.title: Skills clinics
sections.text: Small-group sessions in Austin focused on one skill at a time. Ride better in a group, corner with confidence and finish faster.

items.name: Pack riding & pacelines
items.detail: Ride safely and efficiently in a group: drafting, rotating, signalling and holding a wheel.

items.name: Cornering & descending
items.detail: Lines, braking and body position so you carry speed safely through corners.

items.name: Crit racing 101
items.detail: Positioning, cornering in a bunch, when to move up and how to sprint. Ideal before your first criterium.

sections.title: Training camps
sections.text: A focused block of riding with coaching, route knowledge and good company. A camp is the fastest way to kick-start a season.

items.name: Hill Country weekend camp
items.detail: Two or three days of guided rides on the best roads west of Austin, with daily skills sessions and a ride debrief.

items.name: Spring race-prep camp
items.detail: Get ready for race season with structured efforts, race simulation and tactics sessions.

sections.title: Junior summer camp
sections.text: A week of riding, skills and fun for young riders who want to try racing. Run alongside the Violet Crown Jr Racing Team.

items.name: Junior summer camp
items.detail: Daily morning rides, bike-handling games, basic bike maintenance and a mini race to finish the week. For riders aged roughly 10–17.

sections.title: Ready-made training plans
sections.text: Structured plans you follow in TrainingPeaks at your own pace. The same approach I use with my athletes, without the monthly coaching.

items.name: First century in 12 weeks
items.detail: Build the endurance and fueling habits to finish your first 100-miler strong.

items.name: Texas crit season
items.detail: Sharpen your top-end and repeatability for criterium racing.

items.name: Off-season base
items.detail: A patient winter block of endurance, strength and skills that sets up your spring.

interest_text: Places at clinics and camps are limited. Leave your email and I'll let you know as soon as dates are set.
